questions.text: Explain how you would design and implement a CI/CD pipeline for a microservices architecture using Kubernetes and GitOps principles.
questions.ideal_answer: A robust CI/CD pipeline for microservices with Kubernetes involves several key components. First, implement GitOps using tools like ArgoCD or Flux to manage deployments declaratively from Git repositories. Set up automated build pipelines with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI that build container images, run tests, and push to a registry. Use Helm charts or Kustomize for Kubernetes manifests. Implement progressive delivery with canary deployments using service meshes like Istio. Include automated security scanning with tools like Trivy and automated rollback mechanisms. The pipeline should support multi-environment promotion (dev → staging → production) with environment-specific configurations managed in Git. Monitor deployments with Prometheus and set up alerts for failed deployments or degraded service health.
questions.rationale: Senior DevOps roles require end-to-end pipeline design experience. This question validates knowledge of modern deployment practices and tooling.
